remember-the-ladies-letter.description: A woman in a pale bonnet and shawl sits at a dark wooden table lit by a single candle in a brass holder, writing with a quill on a folded sheet of paper with scribbled lines. A window on the left shows bare trees and a moon, a barn is visible through a window on the right, and an open book, a small ink pot and a sand box sit on the table. The style is a dim, painterly oil look with no frame and no visible text.

declaration-rights-woman-gouges.description: A woman in a dark period dress with a white fichu and bonnet, with a tricolour cockade at her chest, stands on a wooden crate in a narrow stone street. She holds a printed page aloft and shouts toward a crowd of men and women. A torch flares at right and a man in a tricolour-style hat sits in the foreground. The setting and dress suggest late 18th-century Paris. No readable text is legible; the paper shows only indistinct marks. No frame, border, or gore is visible.

vindication-rights-of-woman.description: A woman with dark hair in a loose updo, wearing a dark grey dress with a white collar, sits at a candlelit wooden desk writing with a quill. The desk holds stacks of books, loose handwritten pages, an ink pot and a lit candle on the left. The background is dark and painterly, with a wooden door or panel at the right edge. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.

new-jersey-ends-women-voting.description: An oil-style painting of an outdoor scene at a wooden table beside a brick building. A woman in a bonnet and dark hooded cloak faces a man in a tricorn hat who raises a hand toward her. A seated official in a tricorn hat holds papers beside a wooden ballot box and inkwell. Men in tricorns and long 18th-century coats crowd the porch and doorway. The painting fills the frame, with no visible text, border or wall.

world-anti-slavery-convention-women-barr.description: Interior of a 19th-century hall with dark wood panelling and tall arched windows casting shafts of light. A packed gallery of men in dark suits fills the upper left and middle. In the right foreground, several women in dark bonnets and black dresses sit in a row behind a wooden rail; one, mid-left, holds a pen over a notebook. No visible text.

ain-t-i-a-woman-speech.description: A painting of a Black woman in a white head wrap and long dark shawl and dress stands on a wooden platform in a dim hall with a raised arm, speaking toward a seated audience. Lit wall candles, a wooden pulpit, arched windows and a beamed ceiling fill the room. The audience of men and women in dark 19th-century clothing sits on wooden pews, and the image fills the canvas edge to edge with no visible text.

wyoming-women-vote.description: A woman in a dark 19th-century dress and bonnet drops a paper ballot into a wooden box on a barrel. A line of men in cowboy hats and frontier clothes stands behind her in front of old wooden western storefronts. A sign at the top edge is cropped to a few illegible letter fragments. No frame or border, nothing graphic.

susan-anthony-arrested-voting.description: An older woman with grey hair pulled back, wearing a long black dress with a high collar and a dark fringed shawl, stands at the edge of a dark wood-panelled doorway looking calmly toward a younger man. The man is in a dark, closely buttoned coat with brass buttons and holds a black top hat in one hand, standing in an open street-facing door with a bright street behind him. The interior has patterned wallpaper, gilt-framed pictures and a curtained window. The style is a dark oil-painting look with no visible text.

isle-of-man-women-vote.description: Two women walk along a wet cobbled quay at dusk under a stormy sky. The older one wears a black shawl and bonnet, the younger a green jacket, brown skirt and hat, carrying a small bag. Beside a stone building with a lit doorway, two men in dark coats stand near a lantern. Sailing masts and a rough sea sit in the background. No visible text, frame or border.

australia-federal-women-vote.description: A woman in a white lace-collared blouse, dark skirt and straw hat with a flower trim stands in the foreground, holding a folded paper, looking off to the right. Behind her a line of women in long skirts and hats stands under eucalyptus branches beside a weatherboard wooden building with an open doorway, where another woman in a hat holds something near the door. Harsh sunlight and deep shadow, painterly brushwork, no visible letters or frame.

pankhurst-founds-wspu.description: A woman in a dark high-collared dress stands at right, raising a clenched fist and speaking, lit by a warm lamp. Around a round table with teacups, a teapot and loose papers sit five or six women in dark Edwardian dress, all turned toward her. The dim room has ornate patterned wallpaper, framed portraits on the walls, a door at left and a fireplace glowing at the right edge. No visible text, and the painting fills the frame edge to edge.

finland-women-vote-stand.description: A painterly interior of a formal wood-panelled hall with arched windows showing snow. Men in dark suits sit in a gallery and on benches, and a row of women in black high-collared dresses sits in the foreground, one looking off to the side. Papers are visible on a desk edge at right. No visible text, frame or border.

emily-davison-derby.description: An oil-painting style scene of a racecourse. Racehorses with jockeys in coloured silks gallop on the left across churned green turf, with a crowd of spectators in the stands behind them. On the right, a woman in a long black Edwardian dress and wide-brimmed hat leans over a white rail, facing the track, with stormy grey sky above. Top-hatted men stand at the right edge. No visible text, no frame.

equal-franchise-act-uk.reason: The brick wall carries a large painted sign reading POLLING STATION, and a small hanging sign on the right also has lettering. Repaint without any words.
equal-franchise-act-uk.description: Young women in 1920s cloche hats and long coats chat on a wet cobbled street beside a brick building with a glowing open doorway. A large sign on the wall reads POLLING STATION, and a smaller hanging sign on the right has lettering. A queue of men in flat caps and a uniformed policeman stand behind them. Gas lamps and dark buildings fill the background; the painting fills the frame.

turkey-women-vote.description: A painted interior of a wood-panelled legislative chamber with tall arched windows letting in light. In the foreground a woman in a dark suit and short dark hair leans over a bench toward a seated man, while a second woman in a grey suit sits at a desk with papers, surrounded by men in dark suits. Spectators sit in a gallery in the background. No visible text, frame or graphic content.

france-women-vote-ordinance.description: The painting shows a woman in a worn trench coat and headscarf dropping a folded ballot into a glass box at a wooden table. Behind her a line of women in shawls and headscarves waits in a high-ceilinged room with a carved doorway. Tricolour flags hang on the walls, and a grey-haired man in a dark suit sits at the table beside the box. The style is a realistic oil painting with no visible text, frame or border.

argentina-women-suffrage-law.description: A dense crowd of women with raised fists and open mouths, shouting, many holding white cloths aloft. Most wear headscarves and dark or muted 1940s-style coats and dresses. Behind them is a neoclassical building with columns and a large green-domed congress-style building under a dark, stormy sky. Painterly oil style, filling the full frame edge to edge. No visible text, frame or graphic content.

india-women-vote-constitution.description: An older woman in a dark green blouse and a rust-and-cream shawl looks down at a small dark object held between her fingers, with a bangled wrist visible. Behind her a line of women in saris stands under a large banyan tree with hanging aerial roots, and a brick village building with a doorway and a small pale paper notice sits to the right. Painterly, warm, dappled light, filling the frame edge to edge.

egypt-women-vote.description: A painted interior scene. In the foreground, a woman in a dark dress and cream headscarf holds a folded paper toward a wooden ballot box, where a man in a dark suit receives it. Behind her, a queue of women in headscarves and cardigans stands under stone arches, some holding slips of paper. Through an open door at right, a sunlit street shows minarets and palm trees. The clothing and buildings look mid-20th century, and there is no visible text, frame or wall.

iran-women-vote-referendum.description: A painted scene in dark, warm tones. In the foreground a woman with an updo and a grey trench coat drops a folded paper into a wooden ballot box. Behind her a line of women in headscarves and coats waits, and one woman in a full black chador with a face veil holds a paper. At a table on the right, officials with a ledger sit under a hanging lamp, and a man in a suit writes. No visible text, no frame, and the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.
